VI.description: One iteration of the server loop\2C second half\3A serves the clients with what Track Target found. Service Clients reads and applies each client's input\3B Menu Hover follows a remote pointer over an open menu with keys\3B Retrack Popups lists the popups once more when a client posted something or a popup is open\2C so a popup the input just opened is hidden on the host at once and its overlay goes out before the frame\3B Click State keeps the displacement d and when a client last clicked. Then origin\2C tips and splitters go to the clients when they changed\2C the overlay (at once when the popups changed)\2C a frame (Capture And Send\2C every 16 ms right after input)\2C the other windows and the overlay again (150 ms period in a frame iteration). Closed clients are dropped\2C the status is published and VI Stopped checks once a second whether the shared VI still runs (only while VI Server may be called). stopped? is also TRUE as soon as the panel window that was shared no longer exists (user32 IsWindow.vi in every iteration\2C no VI Server call)\3A a VI started over VI Server keeps running when its panel is closed\2C and the share would otherwise serve a window that is gone.
